description: Expected native results for the @main entry-point wrapper witnesses under the SEH (x86_64-pc-windows-msvc) exception-handling model. A conforming compiler must produce every 'cured' row. The 'defect_signature' documents what the historical unfunded-ownership regression produced, so a red arm is recognizable rather than merely 'nonzero'.

defect_signature.meaning: STATUS_HEAP_CORRUPTION - the allocator detected freed-block metadata corruption (a double free). Any witness producing this is a regression.

witnesses.name: w1_normal_iter
witnesses.note: args is iterator-consumed; the wrapper transfers ownership and must not also clean up on the normal exit.

witnesses.name: w2_mid_iter_panic
witnesses.note: Panic raised after iteration begins; the caught path must not double-free the transferred buffer.

witnesses.name: w3_preloop_panic
witnesses.note: Panic raised before iteration begins; exercises the caught path with the loop never entered.

witnesses.name: w4_borrowed_control
witnesses.note: Borrowed control: the wrapper retains ownership and frees exactly once. The exit code is the returned value (args.len()), not a fault - it must track the argument count.
